title: Independent audit of RULE-01 and Director-authorized integration into main
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Audited Codex commit 9aa11df (BOOT-04 decision review, CHG-20261010-007): it preserves the Director's hosting, engine-placement and D07 decisions and adds qualification gates (measured memory limits; end-to-end WAL archival within the accepted RPO). No decision changed.

Audited Codex commit 6f02557 (RULE-01, CHG-20261010-008) against the backlog acceptance. Present: hashed official source bytes; a nonempty CR 2.2.0→2.3.0 numbered-leaf diff; per-set printing/identity/release-status inventory with denominators; static upstream test inventory including skipped/todo; explicit missing-document, localization and identity-reconciliation gaps. Cross-checked counts against earlier independent measurements of the same pin (3,198 card files; 3,289 test files). The new root dev dependency pdfjs-dist 6.4.299 (Apache-2.0) is exact-pinned with no install scripts, allowBuilds empty and no application import. Script safety reviewed: PDF eval disabled, HTTPS-only bounded fetches, exclusive writes, argument-array git, symlinks not followed, AST parsing without execution.

Independent local Dev Container runs RUN-20261011-006..011 all passed: rules:check, test:rules-inventory, rules:verify-bytes, rules:reproduce, verify:foundation (113 checks = 89 Node + 24 Python), and a fresh download of the official CR 2.2.0/2.3.0 PDFs matching the recorded SHA-256. RUN-20261011-012 docs:check covers this record.

Add an independent-audit section to docs/validation/rule-01.md and update the handoff with the audit results, the Director-authorized integration and the time-sensitive RULE-02/04 inputs (CR 2.3.0 effective 2026-10-16; set 14 Hyperia City prerelease 2026-10-16, release 2026-10-23; upstream covers sets 001–013).

The Director authorized committing, pushing and merging RULE-01 into main. Publish codex/boot-04-decision-review, codex/rule-01-source-inventory and claude/rule-01-audit; fast-forward main to the commit containing this record. No history rewrite.

The first commit attempt was stopped by the staged formatting check (git diff --check): the appended rule-01 audit section left a trailing blank line. Removed it, restored the generated snapshot/changelog from HEAD (nothing had been committed), reopened this record as a draft, re-synchronized, and recorded RUN-20261011-013 docs:check on the corrected content before finalizing.
